subject: Does dropping a participant allow them to re-enroll later on?
body:
Hi Amin,
 
I hope this message finds you well.
 
We have a participant that was accidentally concurrently enrolled in two of our study waves. We would like to drop this participant from one of the study waves, but want to make sure that they are able to re-enroll when it is time for them to enroll. Please let us know if this is possible.
 
Participant:102395
Study that we want to drop them from: 3877 3E Smartphone Substudy (W3)
 
Best,
Lucia

UC San Francisco

subject: Does dropping a participant allow them to re-enroll later on?
body:
Dear Lucia,

Thanks for reaching out to us.

It would be better to delete the participant completely so all their data is deleted. This way they can start from scratch. Please note that you must invite them again if your study's enrollment type is set to "Invitation-based".

Please do not hesitate to contact us for any further assistance.

Best regards,
Milad

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/24198/d3df1a517efb00d2

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: support@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com
